title: Chapter 35 Ao Qing Reveals The Truth
content:
Chapter 35 Ao Qing Reveals The Truth

Sure enough, he and the city lord are completely different people.

"Thank you for your trust, I will definitely build an invincible army and make the evil demons come and go."

Then, Yunqi chatted with Lu Daosheng for a few more words and left.

There were a lot of things in the ring.

And there were also the interstellar ship building drawings that Yunqi had always wanted.

Seeing Yunqi return with a full load, the others were a little jealous.

Then, the others all looked at Lu Daosheng above with fiery eyes.

Sensing everyone's gaze, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled.

Then, Lu Daosheng took out a few more rings and handed them to several people in turn.

"Go, improve your strength well, don't let me down."

Suddenly, everyone's face was overjoyed.

"Yes! City lord."

Soon, only Lu Daosheng, Lu Xue and Ouyang Yanqing were left in the hall.

Below, Ouyang Yanqing looked at Lu Daosheng, blinked, and didn't know what to say.

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke again.

"Ouyang Yanqing, what are your plans?"

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing was a little at a loss.

"I,,"

"Sister Ouyang, why don't you join my Huangcheng."

At this time, Lu Xue smiled.

Lu Daosheng looked at Ouyang Yanqing with a faint smile on his face.

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing was silent for a moment, then nodded.

"Okay, I'll join."

Anyway, I've been staying here all the time, so I might as well join directly.

"Oh, great!"

On the side, Lu Xue suddenly became excited.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng smiled helplessly.

"In that case, from now on, you will be responsible for Xiaoxue's safety."

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing smiled and said, "Okay, Lord City Lord."

Just like that, in the Huangcheng City Lord's Mansion.

Except for a few people who had nothing to do, the rest of the people either began to retreat to improve their strength or began to expand their own forces, waiting for the war a hundred years later.

In a restaurant in the inner city of the deserted city.

Several powerful men with deep auras sat together, all with smiles on their faces.

They were the powerful Saint Kings back then.

And now, they have all entered the realm of the Heavenly Emperor and successfully moved into the inner city.

And Nangong Fang's Nangong family has also become one of the most powerful families in the deserted city.

Second only to those families of the natives of the deserted city.

Those are the real top clans, and they have a close relationship with the honorable city lord.

"Old man, what are your plans in the future?"

The old man with the broken sword took a sip of wine and said with a slightly red face.

Hearing this, the drunk old man said indifferently: "In the future, the deserted city is my home. Wherever the deserted city is, I will be there?"

"Hahaha, this makes sense."

......

At the same time, in the city lord's mansion.

Suddenly, a deafening dragon roar was heard from the Demon God Tower.

The next moment, Ao Qing's huge body soared into the sky from the Demon God Tower.

"Hey? Dad, Xiaoqing is out of retreat."

"Yes, Dad saw it."

Outside the palace, Lu Daosheng and his daughter just watched Ao Qing flying excitedly in the sky.

At this time, Ao Qing noticed the two of them and quickly landed in front of them.

"Master!"

Ao Qing hugged Lu Daosheng's thigh.

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng was a little confused.

"Isn't your master next to you?"

Hearing this, Ao Qing shook his head and said, "No, that's the young master, you are my real master!"

A hundred years ago, Lu Daosheng gave him a drop of ancestral dragon blood, and then he absorbed that drop of ancestral dragon blood and entered the Demon God Tower for retreat.

Now, he has completely refined that drop of ancestral dragon blood, not only breaking the shackles set for him by the powerful in the clan and recovering the unknown realm, but also his bloodline has been greatly improved, and the future is promising.

The key is that Lu Daosheng is still Lu Xue's father, so it is nothing to recognize two masters.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng and Lu Xue, father and daughter, twitched their mouths slightly.

Lu Xue even kicked Ao Qing on the butt, "You stinky dragon who eats outside!"

"My young master, this is wrong. The master is your biological father, how can he be an outsider."

Lu Xue: "..."

"Okay, Ao Qing, tell me first, where is your dragon clan now?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng asked.

As for the dragon clan, there are more or less in many star systems.

However, those are scattered dragons, and their bloodlines are also very impure.

This makes Lu Daosheng a little curious, where is the real dragon clan.

When he gave the blood of the ancestor dragon to Ao Qing, he wanted to test it. Unexpectedly, the other party could really absorb it.

That was the real blood of the ancestor dragon.

It was produced by the system. Any dragon with weaker blood would explode and die after absorbing it.

But Ao Qing not only took only a hundred years to refine it, but his strength also improved very quickly.

Lu Daosheng could see that Ao Qing would soar to the sky in the future.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's question, Ao Qing did not dare to hide it.

"Master, my dragon clan is not in this universe, and I was demoted to this low level because of the mistakes I made back then, ah no, I was demoted to this world."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng suddenly realized.

Then he remembered the gate of rebirth again.

Behind the gate of rebirth, would it be the world where Ao Qing was?

Would his wife, whom he had not seen for a long time, be there too?

"What is the world where your dragon clan is located?"

"Return to the master, it's called the World of All Spirits."

"The world of all spirits?"

"right."

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng became silent.

On the side, Lu Xue's face was full of question marks.

"Xiaoqing, then is your world of all spirits much stronger than here?"

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing felt a little embarrassed.

How to say it.

There is no comparison at all.

However, he only refers to this universe, not including this deserted city.

In his eyes, this deserted city is no worse than any place in their world of all spirits.

Especially his master, Lu Daosheng.

He felt that his master was even more awesome than his father.

"My little master, I guess your universe should be a world that is forbidden by some tribes in the world of all spirits."

"What!"

Lu Xue was suddenly a little unbelievable.

Lu Daosheng, who was beside him, also frowned slightly.

“Continue.”

"Yes, Master."

"Master, do you still remember the evil demon clan in the Evil God Abyss?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

Ao Qing continued, "The evil demon clan is a clan in the world of all spirits. Their favorite is the devouring tribe, so some of the strong men in their clan have forbidden some small worlds for food for the people in their clans to eat. .”

"And this universe is probably one of the small worlds they forbidden."

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng seemed to understand a lot.

After pondering for a moment, Lu Daosheng said in his heart: "System, the function of that rebirth gate is to prevent the evil demons from entering the Hongmeng universe, right?"

[Yes, Lord Host, that is the gate of the evil demon clan entering the Hongmeng Universe. Later, this world was discovered by a powerful person in the world of All Spirits. He felt pity and sealed the entrance]

"But the evil demon clan does not want to give up this world, so he chose to force the border barrier to invade this world, right?"

[The host is really smart. 】

"So that's it."

Lu Daosheng murmured.

At this moment, his smile was a little sarcastic.

The world they live in is just a place where they eat.

It's really ridiculous.

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng's hatred for the evil demon clan reached its peak.

Wait for me, the first thing I do when I enter the world of all spirits is to destroy the entire evil clan.

He has this strength.

"Dad, what should we do?"

At this time, Lu Xue said with some concern.

The enemy they are facing is so powerful that they are not at the same level at all. What should they do?

Seeing his daughter's worried look, Lu Daosheng touched Lu Xue's head and comforted him: "Don't worry, with your father here, you will definitely let those beasts go back and forth."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded.

"Okay, I believe in Dad."

On the side, Ao Qing also said, "Don't worry, little master, there will be no accidents if you have a master in this world."

"Uh-huh."

After Lu Xue and Ao Qing left.

Lu Daosheng's eyes passed through the endless starry sky and kept looking at the boundary of the universe.

Endless evil spirits are constantly attacking the boundaries of the universe.

It is hard to imagine what the entire universe will be destroyed by evil spirits once the barrier is broken.

"It seems that I can't do nothing."

.........

At the boundary of the universe.

"Old Yang, I'm back."

When Duan Heng returned here, the first thing he did was to meet Mr. Yang.

"Well, how is it?"

Mr. Yang nodded and asked.

Immediately, Duan Heng reported the things that were found in the outside world to Mr. Yang.

When Mr. Yang learned that the galaxy forces were not here to support them, but went to a galaxy to seize treasures, his face looked extremely ugly.

The same is true for everyone around.

"What a thing that doesn't know the generality!"

A strong man scolded angrily.

Old Yang waved his hand and said sadly, "What else can you say it out."

Duan Heng nodded.

"Old Yang, I have another good news."

"Oh? Say it quickly."

When Mr. Yang heard the good news, he immediately smiled again.

"Old Yang, I discovered a very powerful force called Huangcheng. I guess that this force should be a hidden force. It has just been born recently, so we have not discovered it."

"Those galaxy forces felt the huge energy fluctuations in the deserted city before they went to seize the treasure."

Hearing this, Old Yang looked surprised.

"Then how powerful is the wasteland city you are talking about?"

Upon hearing this, Duan Heng said with a serious expression: "I only saw an existence above an unknown powerhouse, but he is definitely not the only one, especially his city lord, Mr. Yang, I feel that he is even more terrifying than you."

"What a joke!"

As Duan Heng finished speaking, a strong man on the side immediately said.

The rest of the people around also said, "Brother Duan, this is a bit exaggerated. Looking at the entire universe, Old Yang is already at the top, even more terrifying than Old Yang, and it is impossible."

Everyone nodded.

Seeing this, Duan Heng sighed.

Actually, he didn't believe it, but that's what he told him.
